Core business: prescription drugs (Abilify, Mucosta, nephrology/oncology lines), consumer brands (Pocari Sweat, Nature Made, CalorieMate, SOYJOY), medical devices, and a new insurance services arm. The group posted record 2025 pharma results (+22% revenue, +43% operating profit) across 84+ countries. Taiwan-specific financials aren't published (subsidiary of a listed parent), but the entity has 52 years on the market, TFDA-registered products, and a solid employer brand with active hiring since 2024.

title: CLIMEDI
summary: climedi.com.br CLIMEDI  private multidisciplinary medical clinic and diagnostic center in Aracaju, Sergipe, Brazil — founded 5 Oct 1977 by Dr. João Antônio Macedo Santana (endocrinologist & nuclear medicine physician, UFS professor, SUNY Upstate NY–trained). Family-run (Santana-Macedo dynasty: João, son Gustavo, daughter Sara), with 76–121 staff, 50+ physicians across 3 units. Its unique regional edge: full nuclear medicine — PET-CT, scintigraphy, and I-131 thyroid cancer therapy with 5 CNEN-compliant isolation suites — plus 20+ specialties (endocrinology, cardiology, gastro, mastology, orthopedics, ENT, neuro) and complete diagnostics (MRI, CT, mammography, endoscopy, bone densitometry, 54+ tests). Quality credentials: PNCQ "Excelente" (highest tier), SBAC, DICQ; registered in CNES, works with SUS, private insurers, and union health plans (APCEF+). Government payments total R$ 11M+ (Portal da Transparência); private revenue undisclosed (est. R$ 20–50M/yr).

title: Universidade de Passo Fundo
summary: upf.br Universidade de Passo Fundo private community philanthropic university in Passo Fundo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil — founded 1968 (Decree 62.835), run by the FUPF foundation, with 7 campuses, ~10,000 students, 486 professors (48% PhD), and 100,000+ alumni. It holds the maximum MEC institutional rating (5), ranks 6th among Brazil's best private universities and 5th in research nationally (RUF 2025), and is in the THE World 2026 ranking and top-300 globally for sustainability (GreenMetric). Flagships: Medicine (MEC concept 5, expanding from 750 to 2,000 students with R$ 60M invested), Pharmacy (MEC 5), Veterinary (Hospital Veterinário + 170-ha Cepagro), Engineering (chemical #5 nationally), and Law (70 years old). Financially healthy — R$ 60M annual surplus, independent audits published, board with civil-society oversight; ~70% of students get aid (ProUni, Bolsa Filantropia, FIES, CrediUPF). New rector for 2026–2030: Edison Alencar Casagranda (93% of votes, took office July 2026).

title: Campbell Rhea
summary: campbellrhea.com Campbell Rhea US manufacturer of laboratory and educational casework — legal entity Institutional Casework, Inc. (ICI) — with roots to 1951 in Paris, TN. The brand survived a 2005 tornado that destroyed its former parent Mohon International, was relaunched by local investors in 2006 (CEO Jim Arthurs ever since), and acquired Jamestown Metal Products (NY) plus a steel plant in Union City, TN — 650,000 sq ft of manufacturing total. Products: wood/steel/stainless lab casework, ISOLATOR fume hoods, countertops, athletic lockers (Olympian), Patriot tables — certified SEFA-8, FSC, AIA CES. Revenue $32.1M (2025) per FDMC 300, down from a $63.5M COVID-era peak (2022); ~250 employees, 35+ US dealers, projects at Penn State, UC Davis, Vanderbilt, Case Western, U of Missouri.

title: Newport Beach Dentistry
summary: dentistryofnewportbeach.com Newport Beach Dentistry family dental practice in Newport Beach, CA (1401 Avocado Ave, Ste 209), founded 30+ years ago and currently run by brothers Dr. F. Frank Foroutan (USC DDS 1998) and Dr. F. Ryan Foroutan (USC DDS 1996) — a practice that changed ownership from Dr. Rasch → Kantor/Appelsies → Foroutan over the decades. Services: implants, crowns, veneers, Invisalign, root canals, periodontics, extractions, sedation, whitening, emergency care (same-day); accepts Delta Dental Premier/PPO and most major insurance, CareCredit financing; $99 new-patient special (exam + X-rays + cleaning). Team ~10 (Nancy — office manager, Monica — front desk, Erica — hygienist); languages: English, Farsi, Spanish. Related entities: Foroutan Dental Inc. (Buena Park), OC Elite Dental (Buena Park + Anaheim Hills); also connected to F. Foroutan DDS Inc. (Corona). No revenue disclosed (private practice, est. $2–5M/yr for 3 doctors in this location).

title: Tulsat
summary: tulsat.com TULSAT leading US distributor and repair center for cable TV (CATV) equipment — headend gear, fiber nodes, amplifiers, taps, power supplies — founded 1985 by brothers David and Ken Chymiak in Broken Arrow, OK (100,000+ sq ft). From a bankruptcy buyout it became exclusive Master Distributor and authorized service center for Scientific-Atlanta (now Cisco), plus Motorola/Arris, CommScope, ATX, Quintech. It merged into public ADDvantage Technologies (NASDAQ: AEY) in 1999 (peak revenue $50.3M in 2005), then the cable segment was bought back by David Chymiak's Leveling 8 Inc. for $10.3M in 2019 — private again. Today: ~25 staff, est. ~$10M revenue; group includes NCS Industries (PA), ComTech Services (MO), Tulsat-Atlanta (GA), Nave Communications (MD), Triton Datacom (FL). Core value: largest legacy/obsolete CATV parts inventory + factory-authorized repair, a lifeline for aging networks as cord-cutting shrinks the industry.

title: Shared Medical Technology
summary: sharedmedtech.com Shared Medical Technology, Inc. US medical equipment rental and service company founded in 2004, HQ in Schenectady, NY — 7 offices (NY, MA, VA), ~40–50 staff, no external funding raised. Core business: urgent rental of patient monitors, ventilators, CPAP, ultrasound, portable X-ray, infusion pumps, and bariatric/XL beds and chairs — plus a niche no competitor claims to cover: State Regulatory Compliance certification for transporting XL/bariatric patients across 10+ states (vehicle inspections, certified safe transport). Real clients include Albany Medical Center, OrthoNY, Saratoga Surgery Center, Community Care Physicians, and Brooklyn Surgery Center. Self-developed logistics platform.

title: Santa Barbara Endodontics
summary: sbendo.com Santa Barbara Endodontics solo specialty practice of Dr. Terrell F. Pannkuk, DDS, MScD — one of the most credentialed endodontists in the US — at 9 E Pedregosa St, Santa Barbara, CA, operating since 1987 (39 years). Pannkuk is a Diplomate of the American Board of Endodontics (since 1988), volunteer clinical professor at UCSF, peer reviewer for the Journal of Endodontics, founding president of the Schilder Institute, founder of Pure Dental Learning, and author of a chapter in Ingle's Endodontics (7th ed.) — peers call him "the endodontist's endodontist." Services: root canals, retreatment, apicoectomy, implants, CBCT 3D diagnostics (Carestream 9600), microscope-assisted microsurgery, same-day emergency care. Team of 5 staff.

title: Ecuadors National Police
summary: policia.gob.ec Ecuador's National Police country's main law enforcement agency — 180 years old (institutionalized 1846, professionalized 1938), under the Ministry of Interior, commanded by GraS. Pablo Vinicio Dávila Maldonado (since July 2025). Scale: 58,000+ officers, 14 police schools, 317 per 100K population. 2025 was its most active year ever: 712,642 operations, 71,399 arrests, 227 tons of drugs seized, $9.6B in damage to criminal organizations, 21 high-value targets neutralized — but also Ecuador's deadliest year (8,847 homicides). 2026 shows improvement: −27.7% homicides, −43–56% robberies; new Dinae anti-kidnapping unit achieves 90%+ effectiveness. Budget: ~$1–1.2B/yr from state funds.
